title: ES2020 modules
summary: Parse small to medium ES module files that use import/export and ES2020 syntax (optional chaining, nullish coalescing, BigInt, dynamic import, import.meta) into an ESTree-style syntax tree.
notes: Each package returns its own syntax tree. The verifier walks the trees once per fixture, before any measured work. Several parsers treat input as a classic script unless told it is a module; those keep a default entry that fails verification and a variant with the module setting.
